// xcsu35p xcsu25p xcsu10p
chip CHIP0 {
	kind ultrascaleplus;
	config csec;
	config_alt;
	columns {
		io[0] [
			hdiol, // Y0
			hpio, // Y60
		], // X0
		clel, // X1
		// break
		clem + clk 0..1, // X2
		clel, // X3
		bram + clk 1..5, // X4
		clel, // X5
		// break
		clem + clk 5..6, // X6
		dsp + clk 6..8, // X7
		clem + clk 8..9, // X8
		clel, // X9
		clel + clk 9..10, // X10
		hard[0, clk] [
			cfg, // Y0
			ams, // Y60
		], // X11-X12
		clel, // X13
		clel + clk 10..11, // X14
		clel, // X15
		bram + clk 11..15, // X16
		clel, // X17
		// break
		clem + clk 15..16, // X18
		clel, // X19
		clel + clk 16..17, // X20
		clel, // X21
		clel + clk 17..18, // X22
		hard[1, term] [
			hdiol, // Y0
			hdiol, // Y60
		], // X23-X24
	}
	cols_vbrk X2, X6, X18;
	regs 2;
}

			reflect GCLK_HDISTR_RCLK[1] = GCLK_HDISTR[20];
			reflect GCLK_HDISTR_RCLK[2] = GCLK_HDISTR[21];
			reflect GCLK_HDISTR_RCLK[3] = GCLK_HDISTR[22];
			reflect GCLK_HROUTE_RCLK[0] = GCLK_HROUTE[19];
			reflect GCLK_HROUTE_RCLK[1] = GCLK_HROUTE[20];
			reflect GCLK_HROUTE_RCLK[2] = GCLK_HROUTE[21];
			reflect GCLK_HROUTE_RCLK[3] = GCLK_HROUTE[22];
		}

		connector_class RCLK4_20 {
			reflect GCLK_HDISTR_RCLK[0] = GCLK_HDISTR[20];
			reflect GCLK_HDISTR_RCLK[1] = GCLK_HDISTR[21];

			reflect GCLK_HDISTR_RCLK[3] = GCLK_HDISTR[23];
			reflect GCLK_HROUTE_RCLK[0] = GCLK_HROUTE[20];
			reflect GCLK_HROUTE_RCLK[1] = GCLK_HROUTE[21];
			reflect GCLK_HROUTE_RCLK[2] = GCLK_HROUTE[22];
			reflect GCLK_HROUTE_RCLK[3] = GCLK_HROUTE[23];
		}

		connector_class RCLK_HDIO_CMT {
			reflect CCIO_CMT[0] = CCIO_HDIO[0];
